record.question: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is rare in children, accounting for <5% of all renal tumors of childhood. All the following are true regarding RCC in children EXCEPT
options: patients may present with frank hematuria, flank pain, and/or a palpable mass
it has a propensity to metastasize to the lungs, bone, liver, and brain
it can be associated with von hippel–lindau disease
local lymph node involvement has an adverse outcome
